panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A is a retrograde urethrogram showing a proximal bulbar urethral stricture, which is a classic manifestation of urethral stricture disease. The caption and in-text mention support the findings. B: Panel B is a voiding cystourethrogram showing contrast extravasation to peribulbar veins, a finding associated with urethral stricture during imaging. The vocabulary includes a synonym 'extravasation tract' under fistula tract, so it is tagged as such, though the exact term is proposed.
